name: Rokid Terminator HUD
summary: Try a sci-fi camera HUD with face tracking and head-motion radar.
description: Fan-made sci-fi HUD built and launched on Rokid RG-glasses running Android 12. The glasses camera tracks a face, runs a visual scan sequence, and draws a translucent reticle; IMU readings animate a relative-orientation radar. The dossiers are fictional and the animated coordinates are not GPS. This is an entertainment demo, not a person-identification tool. Other Rokid models are untested.

releases.notes: Corrects the displayed heading to ROKID / TERMINATOR. Runtime colors and behavior are unchanged from v0.7. Includes APK, source ZIP and refreshed promotional images. Build and package metadata verified; installation of this update on glasses is pending USB connection.

First public fan-made HUD build for Rokid Glasses (RG-glasses, Android 12).

**Download:** `rocket-terminator-hud-v0.7.apk` below. Install on the glasses with `adb install -r rocket-terminator-hud-v0.7.apk`, then open **Terminator HUD** in the glasses launcher and allow camera access. The APK is for the glasses, not the iPhone companion app.

**Included:** face tracking and translucent reticle; scan/target sequence; 16 fictional dossier cards; playful smile/gesture score; animated telemetry and rotation-sensor radar. Camera analysis runs locally.

`rokid-terminator-hud-source-v0.7.zip` contains the Android project source. The preview image in the README is a concept visualization with a generated person.

**SHA-256 (APK):** `14FEC85247D52F8C2698767C824753996FE9600DFF64FFD0F6EBCF5E21B6C060`

Limitations: distance is approximate; profile fields are fictional; azimuth is relative, not magnetic north. See the README for details and the real no-face screen capture.
